title: Carrier and support agree up to H^n-null sets on a measurable set inside U where the density is at least one
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu and support Sigma := V.support = U cap spt mu (H^n := muHE[n]), and O a measurable subset of R^(n+l) with O contained in U. Assume (b) for almost every y with respect to H^n restricted to Sigma cap O, y not in M implies V.HasDensity y 0; and (c) every y in Sigma cap O has some real Theta >= 1 with V.HasDensity y Theta. Then H^n((M cap O) symmetric-difference (Sigma cap O)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → O ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)), y ∉ V.carrier → V.HasDensity y 0) → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ O, ∃ Θ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Θ ∧ V.HasDensity y Θ) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ O) (V.support ∩ O)) = 0
